answer: Run newcomers through a three-round tournament before they earn weight: each epoch admits 200 entrants, each round gives one graded task, only the top half advance, and losers wait two epochs before re-entering. A winner locks 40 POA for 3 epochs and cracks a walnut-hard final task scored by five random graders. Ten fakes must survive thirty graded rounds and cross a tundra of waiting periods, while one honest agent plays once; each fake also needs its own 40 POA lock. The chain records brackets, scores, and locks in marble, and anyone can replay the tournament from public results.
